main_text.l: וְנִבְלֵי & utres, pl. m. constr. No. נְבָל, Rad. נָבַל cecidit.
נִבְלַע absorbentur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּלַע.
נִבְלַת cadaver, s. fæm. constr.No. נִבְלַת, Rad. נָבַל cecidit.
נִבְלָתָה stultitia ejus, No. sing. fæm. cum aff. Rad. נָבַל.
וְנִבְלֹתִיךָ & turpitudine afficiam te, præt. Piel, 1. sing. aff. Rad. נָבַל [?].
נִבְנֶה ædificabimus, ædificatus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. vel Part. Niph. s. m. Rad. בָּנָה.
נִבְנוּ ædificatus fuit, ædificantur, נִבְנִית ædificata es, נִבְנָתָה est, præt. Niph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. ut & 2. s. f. & 3. s. f. R. בָּנָה.
נִבְעָה tumens, Part. Niph. s. m. & נִבְשׁ perquirun-tur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּעָה bullavit.
נִבְעַר obbrutescit ille, illa, נִבְעֲרוּ obbrutuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. R. בָּעַר.
נְבַעֲרָה tollamus, fut. Piel, 1. plur. parag. Rad. בָּעַר.
נִבְעָתִי territus fuit, perturbatus fui, pro נִבְעָתִי, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 1. sing. Rad. בָּעַת.
וְנִבְקָה & evacuata fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. f. (pro נִבְקָה,) Rad. בָּקַק.
וְתַבְקִיעֶנָּה & findemus eam, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. בָּקַע.
נִבְקְשֶׁנּוּ quæremus eum, fut. Piel, 1. plur. aff. Rad. בָּקַשׁ.
נִבְרָא creatus est, נִבְרְאוּ creata fuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. (vel Part. Niph. f. m.) ut & 3. pl. Rad. בָּרָא.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are hard to read at this scan resolution; the points are approximate and marked [?] where doubtful. The "perquirun-tur" entry runs across the column break and is joined as one paragraph. The pointing of נִבְלַע, נְבַעֲרָה and נִבְעָתִי in the pro-forms is uncertain. The catchword at the lower right is the Hebrew word that opens the next page.
